name: Inaho Shin
source: Operator of a recently-opened café called "YuKuRu." He refers to himself as "Master" in regards to said café and does not want to be called "Tenchou." He runs the café together with [url=/c66132]Shiogane Kyouko[/url]. A well of adult wisdom and easy-going, [url=/c64629]Kasane[/url] finds himself frequently going to him for advice, and for the coffee he brews. Most of his acquaintances happen to be women.
